# Fixtures of the golden run

Made by `tools/golden_all.sh` with the Python reference (Stable Fast 3D, commit `ff21fc4`) inside the image `mediaorquestator/model3d:sf3d` (id `sha256:48420bf19673`).
Nothing here is a weight. `reference/` is the fp32 run on the CPU (the numerical truth the parity tests compare with); `reference-cuda/` is the run on the card
(times, VRAM and the .glb the container makes). Files under `big/`, `pictures/`, the CUDA run's `small.safetensors` and `160_tets.npz` are regenerated by the golden run and are not committed;
`tools/verify_manifest.sh` checks the ones that exist.
